title: Critique: the principle is a Markov blanket trick

statements.text: The principle only generalizes Bayesian inference to every domain through the Markov blanket formalism, and active inference presupposes successful perception and action instead of explaining them. Neither is as general as claimed.

sources.quote: (i) FEP is just a way to generalize Bayesian inference to all domains by the use of a Markov blanket formalism, a generalization we call the Markov blanket trick; and that (ii) active inference presupposes successful perception and action instead of explaining them.
